title: printenv -J record
description: One environment variable, from `printenv -J`. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

name_bytes.description: The bytes of `name`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`name` then holds the lossy form).

value_bytes.description: The bytes of `value`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`value` then holds the lossy form).
